verified_key_information_units.information: In H1 2026, consolidated EBIT increased by 94% to EUR 51.1 million (from EUR 26.4 million in H1 2025) and EBITDA rose by 31% to EUR 111.2 million (from EUR 85.1 million). Revenue remained broadly unchanged at EUR 946 million (vs EUR 952 million in H1 2025), while net profit turned positive at EUR 7.2 million (compared to a loss of EUR 14.4 million in H1 2025). The group invested approximately EUR 50 million during H1 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures for Q2 2026 (I12), Management Report (I6)

candidate_sentences.text: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization for the first six months increased to 111.2 million euros, up from 85.1 million euros in the first half of 2025.

Operating profit for the six-month period doubled to 51.1 million euros compared with 26.4 million euros in the prior year, while second-quarter operating profit reached 29.7 million euros versus 27.0 million euros in the second quarter of 2025.
Net profit for the six-month period turned positive at 7.2 million euros, recovering from a net loss of 14.4 million euros in the first half of 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: H1 2026 segment EBITDA was EUR 39.3 million for maritime transport (vs EUR 33.3 million in H1 2025), EUR 59.9 million for energy (vs EUR 51.7 million), and EUR 6.5 million for real estate (vs EUR 4.4 million). Supporting segments contributed EBITDA of EUR 5.6 million, improving from a loss of EUR -4.4 million in H1 2025.

In Q2 2026, Tallink Grupp carried 1,454,725 passengers (-2.2% YoY), 68,986 cargo units (+2.9%), and 199,025 passenger vehicles (-6.5%). The segment reported a net loss of EUR 2.5 million (unchanged YoY), impacted by higher fuel costs (up EUR 8.4 million vs Q2 2025), full EU ETS emissions surrender (100% of CO2 equivalent vs 70% in 2025), and the 36-month charter of the Superfast IX vessel from May 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Maritime transport business segment (I7)

verified_key_information_units.information: Elenger Grupp's Q2 2026 gas and electricity sales volumes decreased by 34% to 3.3 TWh (from 4.9 TWh in Q2 2025), primarily due to reduced wholesale sales. The segment held a 29% market share in the Finnish-Baltic gas market. During Q2, Elenger continued developing battery energy storage systems, with a 4.5 MW facility in Liepāja, Latvia entering commercial operation at the start of Q3 2026. Polish subsidiaries secured a EUR 60 million loan agreement to expand the Polish gas business.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Energy business segment (I7-I8)

verified_key_information_units.information: INF Infra continued construction of Rail Baltica's mainline on the Kangru-Saku section (contract value EUR 67.2 million, scheduled to continue until March 2028). Construction of the Depo DIY store adjacent to the Tallink Tennis Centre progressed, with completion planned for autumn 2026. Renovation of 166 rooms at Tallink Express Hotel was completed in May 2026 following closure for renovations since November 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Real Estate Development and Construction Projects (I8)

verified_key_information_units.information: Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 253.2 million as at 30 June 2026 (from EUR 146.4 million at 31 December 2025).
